d:
Finland has been a dream destination for me, and I'm so happy that I finally made it and experienced the stunning northern lights in Lapland! Also, a proposal under the northern lights? What a dream come true.
So in today's video, we're all about exploring Finland's best Arctic resort, Kakslauttanen, for a once-in-a-lifetime glass igloo experience. We're also chasing the Northern Lights on a snowmobile! We will go on a Husky Safari, and feed some reindeer at Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort. It's truly like a winter wonderland. ABSOLUTELY STUNNING!
